traceability.notes: All functional requirements and acceptance criteria in story docs/stories/010.1-DEV-CONFIGURABLE-PATTERNS.story.md are implemented and covered by passing tests. The valid-annotation-format rule now supports configurable regex patterns and examples for both story paths and requirement IDs (nested and flat options), validates patterns safely with explicit configuration errors, preserves backward-compatible defaults when options are missing or invalid, uses JSON Schema for option validation, integrates cleanly alongside the valid-story-reference rule, and is documented in the user API reference. Therefore this story is assessed as PASSED.
